economic_thesis: Abrupt changes in cross-sectional return rank can reflect temporary relative inventory and liquidation pressure. Reversing rank acceleration after removing the common crypto direction should isolate a two-sided effect across rising, falling, and chopping markets.

expected_regime_roles.bear: Remove the common negative move and trade only relative accelerations with exact zero dollar net.
expected_regime_roles.bull: Remove the common positive move and trade only changes in relative leadership.
expected_regime_roles.chop: Repeated two-sided changes in relative leadership should mean-revert over 48 hours.
expected_regime_roles.long_sleeve: Long the sharpest recent deteriorations in relative leadership.
expected_regime_roles.short_sleeve: Short the sharpest recent accelerations in relative leadership.
expected_regime_roles.stress: Broad sleeves, exact dollar neutrality, 0.03 coin caps, and 0.48 maximum gross limit concentration; profitability remains empirical.

falsifier: Reject if the exact no-control reference fails any aggregate, doubled-cost, bull, bear, chop, role, fold, quarter, sleeve, concentration, scheduled-score-coverage, pooled-IC, or fold-IC gate. Controls, neighbors, and private data cannot rescue it.
mechanism: Every 48 hours, convert 75 exact completed 8-hour pure-crypto return cross sections to centered ranks. Reverse each coin's change from prior-six to recent-six mean rank, normalized by the preceding 63-rank volatility and weighted by fixed path coherence. Rank and capture the final score before broad equal-dollar zero-net sleeve construction.
risk_policy_plan: Run only the exact disabled no-control reference; no risk control, stop, neighbor, or private ticket activates before every broad PnL and score-evidence gate passes.
selection_metric: Every noncompensatory no-control and score-evidence gate must pass; no later result substitutes for the exact reference.
